note: Majority: 18. Family Law (Porodični zakon, Službeni list RCG 1/07, as amended to 76/20; the consolidated text 'Katalog propisa 2023' the Government publishes on gov.me): majority is reached at 18, and full legal capacity comes with majority or with marriage before it by the court's leave (the marriage route isn't held). Work: 15. Labour Law (Zakon o radu, Službeni list CG 74/19 of 30.12.2019, read in the consolidated text 'Katalog propisa 2025' that the Agency for Peaceful Settlement of Labour Disputes publishes, with amendments to 84/24; the Assembly's later amending laws of 2025 and 2026 weren't compared) art. 20: a person may conclude a contract of employment from 15 years of age, but not a 15-year-old still in compulsory primary schooling may not be employed; the conditions it sets for those under 18 (a parent's or guardian's written consent and a medical finding) aren't held. Performers: barred, the reading being that the law has no exception for young performers or artistic work below 15. Service: none. Law on the Army of Montenegro (Zakon o Vojsci Crne Gore, Sl. list CG 51/17 and 34/19, the Ministry of Defence's consolidated text of 2019 on gov.me; amendments after 2019 weren't checked) art. 195: voluntary military service of up to six months for a conscript (vojni obveznik) of 18 to 25 with no other citizenship, chosen by public call; compulsory service ended in 2006. Training of conscripts in war or emergency (art. 196) isn't held.

sources.title: Vlada Crne Gore: Porodični zakon, prečišćeni tekst (Katalog propisa 2023)
sources.said: Porodični zakon ("Službeni list Republike Crne Gore", br. 001/07 od 09.01.2007), ... Zakon o izmjenama Porodičnog zakona ("Službeni list Crne Gore", br. 076/20 od 28.07.2020), ... Punoljetstvo se stiče sa navršenom 18 godinom života. ... Potpuna poslovna sposobnost stiče se punoljetstvom ili sklapanjem braka prije punoljetstva uz dozvolu suda.

sources.title: Agencija za mirno rješavanje radnih sporova: Zakon o radu, prečišćeni tekst (Katalog propisa 2025)
sources.said: Zakon o radu ("Službeni list Crne Gore", br. 074/19 od 30.12.2019), ... Opšti uslovi, u smislu stava 1 ovog člana, su: da je lice navršilo najmanje 15 godina života i da ima opštu ... Izuzetno od stava 2 ovog člana lice koje ima 15 godina života, a koje se nalazi na obaveznom osnovnom ... Ugovor o radu može da se zaključi sa licem mlađim od 18 godina života, uz neophodnu pisanu saglasnost

sources.title: Vlada Crne Gore (Ministarstvo odbrane): Zakon o Vojsci Crne Gore, prečišćeni tekst
sources.said: Zakon o izmjenama i dopunama Zakona o Vojsci Crne Gore ("Službeni list Crne Gore", br. 034/19 od ... Na dobrovoljno služenje vojnog roka u trajanju do šest mjeseci može se uputiti vojni obveznik koji ispunjava ... nije mlađi od 18 godina života, niti stariji od 25 godina života;
